---

second wife of the Rev. Edwin Coleridge

According to the marriage announcement Hampshire Telegraph 13 July 1841, she was the daughter of H. Patteson Esq. of Woburn Place. She may have been related to Sir John Patteson (who married her husband’s first cousin Frances Duke Coleridge in 1824) but she wasn’t his sister.
